name: sahayak
description: Sahayak — AI for public good. Eight modules for underserved communities in India.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:env
scripts.setup:env: cp -n backend/.env.example backend/.env || true && cp -n frontend/.env.local.example frontend/.env.local || true
scripts.start: concurrently --names "web,api" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix frontend run start" "cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
